description: V Rising armor sets organized by gear score tier. Includes stats, boss unlocks, and recommended usage. Each tier represents a progression milestone.

armorSets.name: Boneguard Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Crafted from bones at the starting area — no boss required
armorSets.notes: Only option at game start. Replace ASAP.

armorSets.name: Plated Bone Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Kill Alpha Wolf for Leatherworking and Plated Bone recipes
armorSets.notes: First upgrade. Craft immediately after Alpha Wolf.

armorSets.name: Nightstalker Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Requires Leatherworking (from Alpha Wolf) + Copper Ingots
armorSets.notes: +Physical damage helps early PvP. First real armor upgrade.

armorSets.name: Hollowfang Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Defeat Quincey in Dunley Farmlands for the Hollowfang Vestments recipe. Crafted at Tailor Bench.
armorSets.notes: First mid-game armor set. +Health and +Physical — balanced stats for both PvE and PvP.

armorSets.name: Dark Silver Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Kill Octavian for Dark Silver smithing. Crafted at Dark Silver-tier Smithy.
armorSets.notes: Best survivability for its tier. Stepping stone to endgame armor.

armorSets.name: Dawnthorn Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Crafted alongside Dark Silver tier. Unlocked by Octavian.
armorSets.notes: Highest +Health in tier. Mandatory for PvP. The HP bonus lets you survive a full burst combo from most builds.

armorSets.name: Bloodmoon Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Kill Styx for Bloodmoon crafting recipes
armorSets.notes: Preferred for PvE boss killing. Highest +Physical Damage in tier. Dawnthorn still preferred for PvP due to +Health.

armorSets.name: Sunbringer Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Defeat Solarus in Cursed Forest. Crafted at high-tier Tailor Bench.
armorSets.notes: Best pre-endgame set. Balanced stats make it viable for both PvE and PvP before Ancestral.

armorSets.name: Twilight Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Defeat Solarus in Cursed Forest. First endgame-capable armor set.
armorSets.notes: Required before entering Silverlight Hills. First endgame-capable set.

armorSets.name: Sanguine Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Kill Dracula for access to Ancestral Forge. Maximum stats — endgame equalizer.
armorSets.notes: The endgame equalizer — everyone at GS 91 has the same armor. Maximum all stats.

armorSets.name: Ancestral Armor
armorSets.unlockDescription: Best armor in the game. Crafted from Dracula's drops at the Ancestral Forge.
armorSets.notes: Best-in-slot for all builds. Highest defense, best stat bonuses in the game.
